name: Korveld & The Static Saints
description:
Formed in 2211 in the deepest sub-levels of Tier 1's Ashford Sink district, Korveld & The Static Saints are fronted by Davi Korveld-Okafor, a half-blind ex-dockworker whose vocal delivery has been compared to something between a sermon and a riot. The band's sound is built on overdriven industrial percussion, fractured West African kora samples looped until they bleed, and Korveld-Okafor's raw baritone cutting through walls of feedback. Their debut illegal broadcast, transmitted on a pirate neural feed from a condemned cooling tower, crashed three corporate mesh nodes and was replayed an estimated 11 million times before Vantablack Media's suppression algorithms caught up.

The current lineup includes Priya Søndergaard on bass (a self-taught Circuit dropout who tuned her instrument by ear in a Tier 2 machine shop), Emeka Lau-Ferreira on percussion (classically trained in Mongolian throat-singing before dropping out of a Spire conservatory on principle), and Nadia Hess-Oyelaran on modded guitar rigs that can produce subsonic frequencies capable of cracking cheap Shelf construction materials. Their 2219 live set at the Crucible — an illegal underground venue that moved locations weekly — was recorded on contraband data chips and is still circulating as a sacred artifact among Shelf organizers.
creator: Davi Korveld-Okafor
audience: Tier 1 Shelf residents, Tier 2 labor organizers, anti-corporate activists, underground journalists
cultural_impact: Korveld & The Static Saints have become the closest thing Tier 1 has to a political party with a rhythm section. Their song 'Ashford Will Remember' is sung at labor strikes and mutual aid gatherings across the Circuit, and Vantablack Media's repeated attempts to scrub the band from neural feeds have only amplified their legend. Corporate security designates them a civil destabilization asset. To the Shelf, they are simply the sound of staying alive with your dignity intact.
story_hooks: A player character discovers a data chip containing an unheard Korveld & The Static Saints recording that names a specific Vantablack Media executive in a conspiracy — the chip is worth killing for.
Davi Korveld-Okafor has gone missing three days before a massive planned illegal concert, and someone needs to find out whether it was corporate abduction or something the band did themselves.
A Tier 3 corporate analyst has been secretly funding the band anonymously and is about to be exposed — both sides want the player's help managing the fallout.
